reuse.why: Puts the link guards in accounts/link.ts and reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and BankSyncError, but the local unlink resets the same fields as unlinkAccount by hand and Fintegra copies the per-provider link and download bodies.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim sixth copy of the provider link body, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the unlink field reset duplicates unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block.

placement.why: Guards live in link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, the download in sync.ts with the other providers, the server path in server-config and the account type in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: The link rules are centralised in two guards, but a guard that silently mutates another account on a boolean flag and a growing set of copied provider bodies make future changes need edits in many places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureAccountNotLinked in link.ts re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount (app.ts) instead of extracting a shared local-unlink helper

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra link body, Fintegra download, unlink field reset) are plain copies, not reshaped

abstraction_drift.where: ensureAccountNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink boolean parameter and a branch that unlinks the holding account inside what was a pure check; all six link handlers call the guards
